title: High-power perturbations preserve a fibre-dimension bound
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], let $a,b\in S$, and let $d\ge0$ be an integer. For $c\in S$, let $f_c:\operatorname{Spec}(S)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R[t])$ [def-pc-scheme] be induced by the $R$-algebra map $R[t]\to S$ sending $t$ to $c$, where $R[t]$ is the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. If every scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] of $f_a$ has topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most $d$, then there is an integer $n_0\ge0$ such that for every integer $n\ge n_0$ every fibre of $f_{a^n+b}$ has dimension at most $d$. Empty fibres, of dimension $-\infty$, are allowed.
